bannedDependencies.message: The web-app should not depend on the Confluence API classes
Do not put spring-scanner-runtime or annotation in system bundle. They should be deployed as plugins. See CONFDEV-39702, SCANNER-17.
DOm4j 1.x (dom4j:dom4j) has been replaced by Dom4j 2.x (org.dom4j:dom4j)
confluence-webapp must only contain the log4j2.x SLF4J binding
